none: PAS BERK-686065: Roman coin: Barbarous radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper alloy Roman barbarous radiate (contemporary copy) probably imitating a posthumous issue of Claudius II, CONSECRATIO reverse type, dating to the period AD 275-285. Reece Period 14. The obverse bust's features are very crude but well detailed. The eagle on the reverse is also very crude and there is no inscription, rather there is a corded linear border
